This product is supplied without battery and charger. 18V battery required (sold separately, see product code 853FJ).

Milwaukee M18BLIDRC-0 18V Li-Ion RedLithium brushless cordless impact driver designed for professional fastening applications. The compact power tool delivers a powerful 192Nm of torque and 3600rpm through its variable speed trigger, making it ideal for electricians, plumbers, and installers working in confined areas. Designed with a length of 112mm which allows for excellent access in tight spaces. Featuring Redlink overload protection for enhanced system durability and an all-metal reversible belt clip for quick and easy tool hanging. The impact driver also features all-metal gearbox, and provides robust performance and convenience for demanding tasks. Battery and charger sold separately.
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
